facts.claim: Pan American World Airways ceased operations in 1991 after years of decline.
Pan Am II returned in 1996 and merged with Carnival Airlines two years later; Pan Am III was founded in 1998 and out of business by 2004; the fourth iteration operated from 2010 to 2014.
In June 2025, the name briefly returned for all-business class charter flights aboard Boeing 757s, an aircraft type Pan Am never operated, for only a short period.

Avi8 Air Capital began collaborating with Pan American Global Holdings, owner of the Pan Am name rights, and the new entity began seeking FAA certification in October 2025, seeking Part 121 certification.

The new airline will be headquartered in Miami and will operate Airbus aircraft, with A220s or used A320s preferred; CEO Ed Wegel said it intended to operate the A320neo at some point in the future when supply chain and engine issues are resolved.

Part 121 certification can take several months or even years, involving FAA scrutiny of procedures, manuals, maintenance, crew training, route planning, dispatch and dangerous goods procedures, plus on-site checks and proving tests.

The business plan is charter flights mainly to Latin America first, with scheduled passenger services later, three classes of service, and lifestyle ventures including a June 2027 Africa excursion, a September 2027 Ireland golf trip, an October 2027 Holland America Caribbean charter, and a Pan Am Hotel near Los Angeles expected to open in late 2026.

zh.title: 泛美航空過去三度復航分別止於1998年、2004年與2014年，新團隊仍在等FAA認證
zh.summary: 泛美航空原公司於1991年停運後，品牌曾三度復航：1996年版本於1998年與嘉年華航空合併、1998年版本於2004年結束、2010年版本於2014年結束；如今的新團隊自2025年10月起尋求FAA的Part121認證，仍在等待結果，同時以包機與生活品牌方式維持營收。
body: 泛美航空曾是美國實質上的國家航空公司，卻在長期衰退後於1991年停止營運；但品牌並未就此消失。1996年復航的第二代泛美航空於兩年後與嘉年華航空合併，1998年成立的第三代於2004年結束營運，第四代則自2010年營運至2014年。2025年6月，品牌曾短暫以全商務艙波音757包機形式回歸，向黃金年代致敬；但這款機型是泛美航空從未營運過的機型，且包機只維持了短時間。

在包機期間，Avi8AirCapital開始與擁有泛美航空名稱權利的PanAmericanGlobalHoldings合作，評估全面復航的可行性；擬定商業計畫後，新公司自2025年10月起尋求FAA認證以恢復營運，目標是取得FAA對大型飛機定期服務最嚴格的Part121認證。新航空公司總部將設於邁阿密，計畫營運空中巴士飛機，以A220或二手A320為優先；公司也已與Amadeus達成資訊與分銷合作、與AvengersFlightGroup達成模擬機訓練合作，並與空中巴士達成SkyWise數位套件合作。執行長EdWegel先前曾表示，航空公司有意在供應鏈與發動機問題解決後的未來某個時間點營運A320neo。

Part121認證並不容易：FAA會嚴格審查營運程序、手冊、維修計畫、機組資格與訓練、航路規劃、簽派與危險品程序，還會實地檢查與驗證飛行，整個程序可能耗時數月甚至數年；對一家尚無營收的新公司而言，等待愈久，財務壓力愈大。新團隊的商業計畫是先以包機為主、飛往拉丁美洲，定期客運服務之後再推出，並計畫提供三種艙等、先以窄體機營運再加入廣體機；同時也以2027年6月為期19天的非洲包機行程、2027年9月愛爾蘭高爾夫包機行程、2027年10月與荷美郵輪合作的加勒比海行程，以及預計2026年底開幕的洛杉磯泛美酒店，朝生活品牌發展。但報導也指出，新公司沒有常客計畫、航空夥伴、信用卡與企業合約，面對達美航空與聯合航空等大型業者，爭取客源將非常困難。

en.title: Pan Am's past revivals ended in 1998, 2004 and 2014; the new bid still waits on FAA certification
en.summary: Pan American World Airways ceased operations in 1991, and the name has since been revived three times: a 1996 airline that merged with Carnival Airlines in 1998, a 1998 airline that ended in 2004, and a 2010 airline that ended in 2014. A new investor group has sought FAA Part 121 certification since October 2025 and is still waiting, while keeping revenue going with charters and lifestyle ventures.
body: Pan American World Airways was one of the most legendary carriers ever and the de facto flag carrier of the US, yet after years of decline it ceased operations in 1991. The name did not stay dead for long: the name returned in 1996, but that airline, also known as Pan Am II, merged with Carnival Airlines just two years later. The same happened to Pan Am III, founded in 1998 and out of business by 2004, as well as the fourth iteration, which operated from 2010 to 2014. In June 2025, the name briefly returned again for a series of charter flights paying tribute to the airline's golden days, but these were all-business class flights aboard Boeing 757s, an aircraft type Pan Am never operated, and they only operated for a short period of time.

During that time, Avi8 Air Capital began collaborating with Pan American Global Holdings, the owner of the Pan Am name rights, to evaluate the feasibility of fully reviving the Pan Am name again while running the charters. After developing a business plan, the new entity began seeking FAA certification in October 2025 to resume operations, seeking Part 121 certification, the FAA's strictest set of regulations for airlines operating large aircraft on scheduled services. The new airline will be headquartered in Miami and will operate Airbus aircraft, with A220s or used A320s being preferred. CEO Ed Wegel previously stated on LinkedIn in December 2025 that the airline intended to operate the Airbus A320neo at some point in the future when supply chain and engine issues are resolved. The company has also struck a deal with Amadeus to power its IT and distribution, with Avengers Flight Group for simulator training, and with Airbus for the SkyWise Digital Suite.

Part 121 certification is not quick or easy: the FAA will closely scrutinize operating procedures, manuals, maintenance programs, crew qualifications and training, route planning, dispatch and dangerous goods procedures, and will also perform on-site checks and observations, while Pan Am will need to perform proving tests. Certification can take several months or even years, and for a new company with no revenue, the longer it takes, the greater the financial pressure. The business plan is to operate as a charter airline mainly flying to Latin America, with scheduled passenger services coming later, offering three classes of service on narrowbody aircraft and adding widebodies later. Meanwhile, Pan Am is selling tickets for a 19-day all-inclusive excursion throughout Africa in June 2027 on a business-class-only 757-200 operated by Icelandair, has opened bookings for a golf-themed trip to Ireland in September 2027, has partnered with Holland America to charter the cruise ship Zuiderdam for a Caribbean tour departing in October 2027, and is partnering with Hilton to open the Pan Am Hotel at the Citadel Outlets near Los Angeles, expected to open in late 2026. The report also notes the challenge: the new airline has no frequent flyer program, no airline partnerships, no credit cards and no corporate contracts, and most premium passengers today would rather fly with Delta Air Lines or United Airlines.
